description: Sérafin Père et Fils' 2014 Bourgogne Rouge shows mature Pinot Noir in a savory, quietly polished register. Red berries and plum meet cedar-toned spice, with enough freshness to keep the palate composed.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2014 Domaine Sérafin Père et Fils Bourgogne Rouge.
palate: Soft red fruit, light earth, fine tannin
sommelierNotes: Serve at 15-16°C and open shortly before service; choose roast chicken, grilled lamb, or a simple mushroom tart.
